input.original_instruction: Facing the couch, with the TV on the left and the coffee table straight ahead, turn 180 degrees and exit the room. Go inside the room, take a left into the bathroom. Once in the bathroom, turn 180 degrees and head back, not straight but veer right into the open area just to the left of where you came out of and to the right of the small area between the bar. To the right you'll see a glass dining room table with 7, 8 white chairs around it. To the left 3 bar stools and in front of you a TV on a translucent wall. Walk straight ahead with the TV and translucent wall on your left and the dining room chairs on your right. Once you're between the dining room chairs and the TV, you're done.

decision.rationale: The source supports distinct completed navigation objectives. Boundaries are placed only where the preceding objective has a supported outcome and the next stage can continue from that state.
